实际标准化特征距离与近邻投票；投票比例不是校准概率。: Actual standardized distances and neighbour votes. Vote fractions are not calibrated probabilities.
特征贡献加上训练均值形成预测；统计关联不等于因果作用。: Feature contributions plus the training mean form the prediction. Associations are not causal effects.
能量、振幅变化与能量比共同进入逻辑回归；连续三点越阈值形成拾取。: Energy, amplitude changes and ratios enter logistic regression. Three successive threshold crossings produce a pick.
仅用前一天及更早观测预测下一天；测试标签不参与训练。: Only prior observations predict the next day. Test labels do not train the model.
各传感器标准化重构残差的平方相加得到异常分数；异常不等于已证实泄漏。: Squared standardized reconstruction residuals sum to an anomaly score. An anomaly is not a confirmed leak.
TF-IDF 权重只在历史语料拟合，余弦相似度用于检索；没有匹配词时不生成方案。: Historical texts fit TF-IDF, and cosine similarity retrieves matches. No matched terms means no suggestion.
模型只使用参考数据拟合；图中记录来自实际计算。: Only references fit the model. These plotted records come from actual computation.
训练与检验保持分离，先看证据再看指标。: Keep training and evaluation separate; inspect evidence before metrics.
可视化让证据可检查，而不只让页面更好看。: Visualization makes the evidence inspectable, beyond decoration.

这是结构优化算法，不是从标注样本训练的学习模型。: This is a structural optimization algorithm, not a model trained on labelled samples.
使用动态规划最小化分段拟合误差与分层惩罚。: Dynamic programming minimizes segment-fitting error and a segmentation penalty.
层界需要同时考虑段内一致性与层数，不能只逐点判断曲线高低。: Boundaries must balance within-segment consistency and segment count rather than classify individual amplitudes.
GR 曲线 → 区间平方误差 → 全局最优分段 → 调节惩罚并对照层界。: GR log → interval squared error → globally optimal segmentation → penalty adjustment and boundary comparison.
曲线、层界和误差的联动用于检查结构约束的作用，不能当成真实地层解释结论。: Linked logs, boundaries and errors expose the role of structural constraints; they do not establish real geological interpretations.
基线采用4点短窗与最多16点长窗的能量比，首次超过2.2触发；AI分数连续3点越: The baseline uses a 4-sample/at-most-16-sample energy ratio and its first crossing of 2.2; AI requires three consecutive score crossings.
A 区块有 42 口开发井，常规曲线齐全，解释组按油田统一分层方案手工卡出 8: Teaching scenario: Block A has 42 development wells and eight marker boundaries. The illustrative target is to reduce per-well picking time from 3.5 hours to 15 minutes of review while keeping boundary deviations within 0.5 m.
下面五步是这个案例的真实流程。注意第 2 步和第 4 步：它们不涉及任何模型，却: The following five steps describe the scenario workflow. Steps 2 and 4 do not use a model but can determine whether its output is usable.
厚度小于最小层厚（本例 1 m）的层在惩罚项下会被合并。解决方向是分层建模：先粗: Layers thinner than the minimum interval may be merged by the penalty. A hierarchical approach can identify large units first and inspect thin intervals separately.
岩性渐变时曲线没有突变点，算法倾向把过渡带整体归入一侧。可用斜率特征或软分割概率: Gradual changes lack a sharp jump, so a transition may be assigned to one side. Slope features or soft boundaries can help.
某条曲线在井段内缺失时，多通道模型会被\"补零\"误导。应先做缺失标记，让模型显: Missing channels must be marked explicitly rather than replaced by misleading zero values.
算法可能给出与区域地层方案矛盾的层序（如标志层倒置）。必须加层序约束或人工审核规: Output can conflict with the regional stratigraphic order. Apply ordering constraints or manual review.
流程中的工时与井数是教学情境设定，并非当前运行实测。: Well counts and work-time figures are teaching-scenario assumptions, not measurements from this run.
时间靠前的参考窗口拟合产量变化系数。: Earlier reference windows fit coefficients for rate changes.
只用已发生观测和预先给定的合成周期，预测变化后叠加昨日量；不读取未来产量。: Observed lags and a preset synthetic cycle predict the change added to yesterday’s rate; future rates are not read.
